page.title: LI Freight Distribution Network (FDN)
page.t: Notify when a DC cannot pay
Manager skill sets range and fees
Buy shortfalls from NPC stations when no DC can supply them
0 = off, 1 = problems only, 2 = problems and one summary per supply run, 3 = problems and every transfer
Show an on-screen message when a transfer is skipped because the DC cannot pay the fee
Seconds before the same skipped station and ware is written to the logbook again
On-screen message and logbook entry when a station stays short of a ware FDN cannot supply, or a DC stays low on stock
Game minutes a shortage must last before the first alert
Minimum game minutes between two alerts for the same station or DC and ware
How many stations each supply pass looks at
Minimum seconds between two production-finished checks of the same station
How many production cycles of resources FDN keeps stations supplied ahead. Also sets the station resource stock levels for wares it does not make itself \(wares it makes are left to the game\)
FDN delivers the resources your production stations need and sets their resource stock levels \(wares a station makes itself are left to the game\)
FDN also sets the trade buy limit of each resource it sets a stock level for to that same level, and turns buying on. Off puts your own buy limits back
Station products are moved to the nearest Distribution Centre. Surplus resources are collected too

Only collect when stock is this percent above the keep amount \(0 = any surplus\). For resources the station also makes, keep is the FDN cycles-to-cover need; for other resources it is the station storage level. Surplus above keep is moved, limited by DC free storage
Cycles of each product a station keeps before sending the rest to the DC. 0 = send everything once the smallest batch has built up
Smallest amount of a product sent to the DC in one go
Maximum gate jumps between two DCs for them to share stock
Share of each ware a DC always keeps for itself
Maximum ledger entries kept per DC
Only supply stations within the maximum range below
Maximum gate jumps between a DC and the station it supplies
Each DC manager sets that DC range \(3 to 5 jumps\), DC link range \(6 to 10 jumps\) and fee discount \(10% per star\). A DC with no manager is offline. Off = flat ranges and fees
Transfers take time per gate jump instead of arriving instantly
Seconds of delay per gate jump when transfers are delayed
Fee as a percentage of the value of the wares moved \(0.0 to 10.0 in steps of 0.5\)
Fee rises by this share of the base fee for every gate jump \(0.2 = +20% per jump\)
Multiplier on the fee for ware volume \(1.0 = no change\)
Multiplier on the fee for ware type \(1.0 = no change\)
Fee for products returned to a DC, as a multiplier of the normal fee \(0.5 = half\). The DC pays
Fee for stock pulled between DCs, as a multiplier of the normal fee. 0 makes pulls free
Charter fee as a share of the price of the most expensive qualifying dock on the station
Lowest charter fee before the reputation discount
Highest charter fee before the reputation discount
Standing needed with the sector owner \(or your best main faction\) to buy a charter. -30 = no limit
Standing that gives the first charter discount
Percent off the charter fee at the first standing step
Standing that gives the second charter discount
Percent off the charter fee at the second standing step
Standing that gives the third charter discount
Percent off the charter fee at the third standing step
Write FDN lines to the game debug log \(fdn.log\)
1 = errors, 2 = and warnings, 3 = and info, 4 = and debug detail
Click to put every FDN setting back to its default. Reopen this page to see the new values
Reload the figures. The page does not update by itself
No Freight Distribution Centres. Buy an FDN charter from a station right-click menu to make one

More not shown: the page holds at most 160 rows. %1 of %2 wares listed

FDN Alerts: shortages, needs attention and problems
FDN History: last 24 hours and recent activity
Freight Distribution Network, read only. Totals since charter bought
Total stock as a percent of the storage targets of the wares in stock that have a target
\(no working dock, the charter ends soon if none returns\)
FDN Ware Rules for this DC \(%1 set\)
Stock, Keep %, Never send, Do not accept
Manager: %1 stars \(skill %2\). Supply range %3 jumps, DC links %4 jumps, fee discount %5
Manager: none. FDN does not use this DC until a manager is assigned
Totals: %1 supplies sent, %2 returns received, %3 units moved, fees paid %4
Stations and DCs FDN could not serve, newest first
Stations short of a ware FDN could not supply, and DCs running low. An alert is shown once a shortage lasts the Shortage alert after setting
No DC exists, so the FDN supplies nothing and stations trade as normal
Show the next DC \(by name\), then All DCs again
Last 24 hours in 1-hour buckets. Supplies, returns, collects and units are counted from FDN 1.02 on; fees go back up to 24 hours.
Recent activity, whole network \(%1: %2 of %3 stored entries\)
Change what Recent activity shows: All, Supplies, Returns \(incl. collect\), NPC, Problems
No supplies or returns recorded yet
This DC no longer exists or has no charter. Go back to FDN DCs and open the rules for another DC
Click again to reset %1 rules to Stock
Set every ware at this DC back to Stock \(normal behaviour\). Needs a second click
Stock: normal. Keep %: keeps that share of its storage target and supplies only above it. Never send: never supplies it to stations, still takes returns and collects.
Keep % uses the storage target, or the current stock when the ware has no target. The global DC reserve still applies; the larger reserve wins

Do not accept: takes no returns or collected overstock of it and is never picked as a destination for it, still supplies what it has. Click a button for the next value, right-click for the previous one.
No wares in stock or set to trade here
Click: next rule \(Stock, Keep %, Never send, Do not accept\). Right-click: previous rule
